productionBlockers: Fullfixed timer prediction would query dynamic colliders updated only by RAF single network.present/syncBodies; disconnect seat cleanup is also RAF-owned.

Input-only online timer must not consume offline short taps: current offline path immediately predicts consumed controls and has no pending network row. Require exclusive offline RAF ownership or another proved bounded path.

A bounded prediction-through cursor must fence connection generation, first self, body/controlRevision/observer and seq wrap; advance only successful steps, reset to authorityACK after replay rollback and preserve already-ACKed-but-never-locally-predicted durations in authoritative state.

Current onSelf replay also has the preexisting dynamic-collider freshness limitation; adding more pending during RAF holes does not solve it. A fresh-collider authoritative-baseline/RAF replay variant needs exact reconciliation tests.
No second network.present, extra/unbounded input queue, allpending replay each frame, NPC advance, rate/cap reduction or pedestrian coalescing.

limitations: Headless blank timers demonstrate mechanism only; this is not native GPU/VSync/OS scheduling, FPS, input-latency or GC improvement evidence.
A timer cannot run during actual main-thread JS/GC blocking or OS descheduling; the busy-loop negative control preserves that fact.
The314.5ms historical trace lacks per-fixed-call chronology, so exact lost/admitted input counts are not claimed.
Full48 window and authority throughput remain unresolved; independent sampling may sustain lead rather than fix it.
